headline: Lam Research (LRCX) Is Up 6.1% After AI-Fueled Beat And Raised Chip-Equipment Outlook
summary: Lam Research reported quarterly revenue growth of 24% year over year and earnings above guidance. It raised its outlook for wafer fabrication equipment demand, citing strong AI-driven orders.
why: Lam Research makes semiconductor manufacturing equipment, so its orders signal capital spending by chipmakers. Its results are a read-through for the AI-driven chip investment cycle.

impacts.name: Lam Research
impacts.why: Earnings beat and raised outlook for wafer fabrication equipment demand drove the share gain.
